about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Fourth Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech Thee, merciful God, that we may receive with sincere devotion and ever with a faithful mind the holy things wherewith we are ceaselessly filled. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
